verdict.rationale: Alloy documents a real API for its core decisioning operations: the Events API, Evaluation API responses with service status and warnings that mirror the dashboard, webhooks, and a /healthcheck endpoint. That shows its main runtime functions are reachable programmatically. Nothing claims or shows UI parity, though: workflow and Journey configuration, webhook settings, and SSO/SCIM setup are only described as settings, not API endpoints. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, documented API coverage of admin and configuration tasks (workflows, Journeys, webhook management, users), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
